arguments.command:
set -u
printf 'LINKED_WORKTREE_STATUS\n'
git worktree list --porcelain | awk '/^worktree /{print substr($0,10)}' | while IFS= read -r wt; do
  branch=$(git -C "$wt" symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || printf 'DETACHED')
  head=$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse --short=12 HEAD 2>/dev/null || printf 'UNKNOWN')
  st=$(git -C "$wt" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all 2>/dev/null) || { printf '%s|%s|%s|STATUS_FAILED\n' "$wt" "$branch" "$head"; continue; }
  if [ -z "$st" ]; then
    printf '%s|%s|%s|clean\n' "$wt" "$branch" "$head"
  else
    tracked=$(printf '%s\n' "$st" | awk 'substr($0,1,2)!="??"{n++} END{print n+0}')
    untracked=$(printf '%s\n' "$st" | awk 'substr($0,1,2)=="??"{n++} END{print n+0}')
    ignored=0
    printf '%s|%s|%s|dirty|tracked=%s|untracked=%s\n' "$wt" "$branch" "$head" "$tracked" "$untracked"
  fi
done
